written: 2026-10-12, before any SDPC or BP-set test-set number was computed
target: frozen latents, layer emb (pred_target_check.json), standardised with train stats (pred_ff.load)
primary_backbone: bp (runs/bp_sigreg_e400); control: rand (same architecture at init, PRNGKey(0))
validation: last 10% of train images; SDPC hyperparameters (lam, beta, lam_decay) chosen by lowest val k=1 nmse at T_inf=50, 1500 steps (pred_runs/sdpc_sweep.json); BP set predictor uses fixed defaults (width 256, lr 1e-3, 6000 steps)
methods: feedforward BP and PC (k=1 only, pred_ff, curvature-tracking PC step)

tests.a_k_seen: k in {1,2,3}, cases pred_eval.k_cases(2000,k); k=1 also on the 12 ordered pairs (pred_eval.eval_pairs) for comparison with pred_ff
tests.b_robustness: k in {1,2}: corrupt ONE seen view (the first in the case's permutation) in pixel space and re-encode: gaussian sigma 0.1, 0.2; occlusion 25% area (16x16 square, zeros); seed 0; report nmse/cos/retr1 and degradation = metric(corrupt) - metric(clean)
tests.c_inference_budget: SDPC test nmse at T_inf in {5,10,25,50,100,200} with the trained dictionaries
tests.d_backbones: all tests on bp; tests a and c also on rand

seeds: SDPC and BP set: 3 seeds on bp, 3 on rand (if time allows, otherwise 1 on rand, declared)
claims_tested: H1: SDPC error falls with k faster than BP set (fusion of evidence through inference)
H2: SDPC degrades less than BP set / feedforward under corruption of a seen view (robustness)
H3: SDPC test error keeps improving with T_inf beyond the training budget (inference does useful work)
metrics: nmse (primary), cosine, retrieval@1 among 2000 test images of the same target view
